author: Community
title: Community meeting this Saturday
body: Town hall meeting at the Clara Town community hall, 10:00 AM Saturday. Agenda: street cleaning, water points, and the new kehkeh stop near the school. All welcome.

author: Community
title: Lost wallet near Waterside Market
body: Lost a brown wallet near the fish market entrance around 2 PM today. Contains ID and some cash. Please call +231 6 555 0142 if found.

author: Community
title: Shop attendant needed in Duala
body: Provisions shop on the main Duala road needs a shop attendant. Mon-Sat, 8 AM-6 PM. Call +231 88 555 0177.

author: Community
title: Street light out on Tubman Boulevard
body: The street light near the Sinkor junction has been out for a week. Please be careful walking at night. Reported to the community watch.

author: Community
title: Fresh cassava and plantain sale
body: Farmer selling bags of cassava and ripe plantain at the Banjor junction, LRD 800 per bag. Today and tomorrow only.

author: Community
title: Water schedule this week
body: Liberia Water Corporation: water in ELWA and Pipeline Tuesday and Friday, 6 AM-12 noon. Store water on those days.

author: Community
title: Youth football tournament - Red Hill
body: Youth football tournament at Red Hill field this Sunday, 2 PM. Teams from Paynesville, Gardnersville and Red Light. Spectators welcome.

author: Community
title: Lost phone (Tecno) at Red Light
body: Lost a black Tecno phone near the kehkeh garage yesterday afternoon. Reward if returned. +231 77 555 0190.

author: Community
title: Tailor apprentice wanted
body: Tailor shop in Bushrod Island looking for an apprentice. Learn Lappa and alterations. Contact +231 6 555 0163.

author: Community
title: Power outage notice - Congo Town
body: Libtelco expects outages in Congo Town on Thursday 10 AM-2 PM for line maintenance. Plan ahead.

author: Community
title: Phone accessories clearance sale
body: Phone accessories shop near New Kru Town market: cases LRD 200, chargers LRD 300 this week only.

author: Community
title: Beach clean-up, West Point
body: Community beach clean-up at West Point beach, Saturday 7 AM. Gloves and bags provided. Bring friends!
